column1: # Suite table: the single list of suites (test-pyramid tier.1, tier.2).
# scripts/shell-files (lint). Tab-separated; '-' marks an empty field.
# Columns: name  tier  cmd  budget_s  serial  why  paths
#   tier      fixture | slow (QUEST.md Terms). OCaml unit tests run via
#             `dune test` in `make check`; fixture and slow rows join it in
#             `make check-full`, the grade/land gate. A suite is slow iff it
#             proves what no fake can: a real process tree, signals, real
#             wall-clock waits, or concurrent writers (red-ink R7); slow rows
#   budget_s  a hang guard, hand-set (red-ink R2', owner 2026-11-19): max(60,
#             6x the suite's time under run-suites on a quiet machine),
#             rounded up to the next 30s. It catches hangs, not slowness:
#             a busy laptop runs suites 2.5-5x slower and must still pass.
#             Slowness is read from `run-suites --report`, never failed.
#   serial    1 when the suite writes the real repo tree; serial rows never overlap.
#   paths     globs that select the suite for a changed file (red-ink R3').
# The OCaml unit tests run through `dune test` (make check), not as a row.
